name: CheckOutFile
description: Checks out a file in Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API to enable editing.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and check out files in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to check out (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns metadata of the checked-out file, including ID, URL, and checkout status.
